storageCorrection.before: The site can save theme and language preferences in your browser. Blocking browser storage does not prevent browsing.
storageCorrection.after: The site can save theme and language preferences in your browser. If saving is blocked, those preferences may not be remembered on a later visit.
storageCorrection.reason: Narrow to preference persistence; actual whole-browser/all-storage resilience has not been qualified.

feedback.text: GitHub issues are public and require a GitHub account to submit. Do not include order details, payment information, addresses, or other private information. A private website-feedback channel is not published here yet.
feedback.proposedDisposition: Keep public GitHub defect reports during setup; retain a private accessible alternative as explicit pre-launch work in #9. This is a proposal and does not close #90.
